label: Labeller AI Demo
info:
Solo Smart Factory labeller - read-only monitoring dashboard with AI insights.

Dashboard: http://<device-ip>:1880/labeller

1. CONFIG / TAG MAP - edit here
2. Sources: DI (GPIO tab links), Mitsubishi serial (disabled), Simulator
3. Mapper -> 4. Analytics -> websocket + SQLite

Nothing on this tab writes to the machine.

name: ① CONFIG + TAG MAP — edit these two nodes
info:
CONFIG: line, shifts, simulate on/off, storage limits, chat provider, PLC protocol.
TAG MAP: where each machine value comes from (DI0..3 or PLC D/M registers).
Redeploy after editing.

name: CONFIG
TAG MAP
② SOURCES — all produce raw {src,key,value}
info:
DI: from the GPIO tab (one node per pin rule).
Simulator: active while CONFIG.simulate = true; writes the same raw keys the real machine would.
Mitsubishi serial: enable "PLC poll" + "PLC serial" when the PLC is wired, set CONFIG.simulate = false.
